items: Indulge in the comfort and softness of our long bib pants jumpsuit. These summer jumpsuits for women are made of 100% cotton. Soft, comfortable and airy for hot summer and humid days.As a bohemian overalls for women, it comes with a vibrant floral print, that can be eye-catching in the crowd,these long bib pants will add a splash of color to your summer wardrobe.

You'll love these casual jumpsuits to throw on, on those lazy days. The loose fit and low crotch allowing for ease of movement and a relaxed, carefree vibe without sacrificing a neat silhouette. Two side pockets are functional for carrying some small items.

Our summer floral overalls for women feature simple but great designs. The way the torso is cut gives you a flattering waistline while offering relaxed comfort, whether you are curvy or petite. Adjustable straps and elastic under the arms ensure a better fit. With slits at the bottom, flowy wide leg overalls gracefully rest on your shoes.

These boho rompers are great for summer beach, vacation, travel, holiday, lounge wear, school, office, or church. They're also great for transitioning into fall with a light jacket or a long-sleeved undershirt. You will find yourself reaching for these floral jumpsuits time and time again.
Hand Wash Cold; Soft Machine Washing; Line Dry; Do not Soak; Classification of Washing; Iron at Low Temperature if Necessary.
